sinopsis.es: Ecocidio es un cortometraje animado realizado con arcilla fresca. Trata sobre la historia del ecocidio vista desde los ojos de la Pachamama, una anciana de barro que siente calor y no puede dormir porque descubre que la temperatura global es muy elevada. Al ver la cantidad de acciones naturalizadas que dañan al medio ambiente, entristece, además de reconocer que la humanidad es incapaz de modificar su accionar.
sinopsis.en: Ecocidio is an animated short film made with fresh clay. It deals with the history of ecocide as seen through the eyes of Pachamama, an old woman made of clay who feels hot and cannot sleep upon discovering that global temperature is very high. It saddens her to see the many normalized actions that harm the environment, as well as to recognize that human beings are incapable of modifying their actions.
